title: Christlike Service
definition: Christlike Service is the Christlike use of strength, gifts, time, and resources for the good of people and the glory of God.
summary: Christlike Service is humble action for the good of others patterned after Jesus, who came not to be served but to serve.
christFocus: Jesus Christ came not to be served but to serve, and He empowers His people to serve in His name.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Christlike service is humble action for the good of others and the glory of God. Scripture roots service in Jesus Himself, who came not to be served but to serve.

This service is not people-pleasing, self-promotion, or resentment covered with religious language. It flows from secure love and obedience to God.

Jesus dignifies lowly service by taking the servant's place. Those who follow Him learn to use strength, gifts, time, and resources for others.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Service can become a platform for recognition or a burden fueled by guilt. Christlike service restores joy and humility by keeping the servant's eyes on Jesus.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Serve somewhere no one may notice. Check whether your service is driven by love, guilt, pride, or fear, and ask Christ to make ordinary help an act of worship.
